items.title: Joe Wilder Part 1 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I did a lot of Broadway shows but the last one I did was “42nd Street” the David Merrick show

ctx.x: What are some of your favorite things you’ve done in the last couple of years?

The things I’ve done in the last few years? Well I did, well I was lucky enough to play a Broadway musical that ran eight and a half years. I did a lot of Broadway shows but the last one I did was “42nd Street” the David Merrick show, and that ran for eight and a half years. So that was a long run. It’s not a long run by “A Chorus Line” standards or “Cats,” those shows are still going, and “Les Mis’” they’re really setting records. But they’re good shows you know.
